title: Pasta Carbonara
instructions: Cook spaghetti. Mix eggs, bacon, and Parmesan. Combine with cooked spaghetti. Add pepper to taste.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
instructions: Stir-fry chicken and vegetables. Add soy sauce, ginger, and garlic. Cook until chicken is done.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven. Mix flour, sugar, butter, chocolate chips, and vanilla extract. Form dough into cookies. Bake until golden brown.

title: Caprese Salad
instructions: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella. Arrange on a plate with basil leaves. Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cook ground beef, add in onions. Then add in beef broth and cream cheese. Stir until mixed, then add egg noodles, and salt and pepper to taste

title: 2AM Nachos
instructions: Sprinkle shredded cheese on a plate of tortilla chips. Microwave for 30 seconds.
